UI consistency audit complete. Here's the summary:

## Result: CONVERGED — 0 inconsistencies, 0 fixes (6th consecutive clean UI-consistency audit)

I ran both a **definitive code-level grep over all of `client/src`** and a **Playwright runtime walk** of 8 pages plus the Import modal. Everything is on-standard.

**AUDIT 1 — Icons** ✅ 38 `@heroicons/react/24/outline` imports across 37 files. Zero solid/lucide/react-icons/FontAwesome/Material imports. Runtime: every page (Dashboard 70, Pipeline 77, Leads 38, Invoices 37, WorkOrders 33, Calendar/Tasks/Settings 31) showed 0 foreign SVGs, 0 `fa-*`. The only inline `<svg>` in live components are the decorative map SVGs in `CanvassingMode`/`StormMap` (allowed, FEMA-adjacent — untouched).

**AUDIT 2 — Buttons** ✅ Radii group cleanly into design-system tokens (12px primary, 8px tabs/secondary, 0px text-buttons). The `14px/12px` and `10px/8px` values are CSS border-radius *clamping* on short elements, not one-off styles.

**AUDIT 3/4 — Header & Sidebar** ✅ Shared TopBar + Sidebar render consistently on every page.

**AUDIT 5 — Forms** ✅ Zero native `<select>` and zero native `<input type="date">` in the entire tree — `CustomSelect`/`DatePicker` enforced. The Leads filter chips ("All Stages", etc.) are `CustomSelect` buttons, not native selects.

**AUDIT 6 — Spacing** ✅ `--space-*`/`--radius-*` tokens; no overflow drift.

**AUDIT 7 — Modals** ✅ The recurring failure mode (new modal files reintroducing inline animation drift) is clean: only `LeadDetail.jsx:1792/1919` have inline animation and both are byte-identical to canonical. Verified the new `CalendarView.jsx` and the ImportLeadsModal at runtime — Import modal renders `.modal-backdrop > .glass` with `modal-scale-in 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both`.

**Per charter ("if it works, leave it alone"): no code changes, no commits.**

Two notes:
- The uncommitted `ImportLeadsModal.jsx` edit (adds an unused `useEffect` import) belongs to the concurrent keyboard-nav/a11y stage — I left it untouched and confirmed it doesn't break the modal.
- Deliverable written to `C:\tmp\ui-audit-results.txt`; resume updated for the next run.

Genuinely untouched high-value gaps remain for other stages: full a11y/axe-core sweep, keyboard nav (Esc-to-close still missing app-wide), and the tablet-768px sweep.
